stub.section: Along trail to E. Br. Sacandaga River

alerts.detail: Dangerous, river-wide strainer in upper rapid (first "gorge") on County Line. A Tributary enters on river left; the strainer is stuck in a rapid approximately 150 yds below this tributary. There is a pretty easy eddy on river right before the strainer. The portage is a pain, but possible.

Posted for Michael Feldman:

There are two new strainers in the water. The first one is half way down the put in waterfall, submerged in the hole. It's about 6 to 8 " diameter and about ten feet long. Branches were visible above the surface.

The second strainer, approximately the same size, is located just above 'Big Boof' off river right and submerged.

I've trimmed both strainers to make it passable. However, both have the potential to migrate downstream.

Thank you, Mike

detail.description:
If the last drop looks good then you have enough water for the run. Hike up the trail on the left side of the creek for 1.75 miles then head to the river. If it is flat then you've gone far enough. If the creek is really high an extra half mile walk will bring you to the hardest drop on the run.

The entire run is solid Class 4 creeking from the putin on down. Expect slides aand boofs throughout. Enjoy, but keep an eye out for strainers.

According to Adrian Vanden Bout, this run requires an hour-long, two-mile hike in from the road--but it's worth it. It often collects wood; scout from the trail.
